definition.name: Standalone fixed topology capacity and exact byte precharge

steps.name: Execute full fixed topology and exact selected Vec precharge
steps.run:
set -o pipefail
cargo test --locked -p latentd --lib standalone::observations::topology::tests:: -- --show-output --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/standalone-topology.log"
grep -F 'test result: ok. 5 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' "$RUNNER_TEMP/standalone-topology.log"
grep -F 'test standalone::observations::topology::tests::standalone_capacity_covers_every_optional_topology_row ... ok' "$RUNNER_TEMP/standalone-topology.log"
grep -F 'test standalone::observations::topology::tests::standalone_topology_precharges_exact_selected_vec_capacity ... ok' "$RUNNER_TEMP/standalone-topology.log"

steps.name: Verify standalone derivation retains generic and snapshot byte limits
steps.run:
set -o pipefail
cargo test --locked -p latentd --lib config::tests::defaults_derive_compatible_node_limits_without_creating_storage -- --exact --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/standalone-topology-config.log"
grep -F 'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' "$RUNNER_TEMP/standalone-topology-config.log"

steps.name: Retain exact reporter and capacity results

reviewReason: Capture successful counter output after exact named results via --show-output, retaining five required topology cases and config case. No runtime, source selection, bounds or original reference changes.
